published.source: forever-sim's paladin re-search on the October 30 hotfix trees, 2026-11-01 (wowsimcli on this request, 20,000 iterations, seed 1, 180 ± 20 s); the DPS report data isn't regenerated yet

summary: Ret twist with the side points in Holy: Divine Precision and Reverence instead of Precision.
rotation: The spell power on-use trinket at the pull, then held for the execute phase when that loses no use; Goblin Sapper Charge on cooldown
Hammer of Wrath under 20% boss health, before Consecration
Judgement on cooldown on whichever damage seal is up
Seal of Command whenever no damage seal is up

Unsealed Wrath: with Seal of Command up, once it has stored 2 copies, Seal of Righteousness, so the next swing spends them all (one Seal of Command roll each) and stores a Righteousness copy. Back to Seal of Command once that copy is stored
Exorcism on cooldown (only against Undead and Demons)
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Takes Pursuit of Justice 2 (movement speed), a must-have talent.
Unsealed Wrath is new with the October 30 hotfix and unverified: the sim lets landed white swings store and spend the copies, and rolls each stored Seal of Command at its own 7 a minute.

Two-Handed Weapon Specialization boosts the Holy seal and judgement damage and Holy Strike too, as measured in game before the October 30 hotfix. The hotfix tooltip says physical damage, but its damage effect is unchanged.
Unverified: Holy Strike's flat bonus is added before its weapon damage percent, as the client data says.
The top Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% of DPS).

Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power per hit with a two-hander, counted once, as its tooltip says (spell 70425). Counted twice, DPS would be 46-51 higher. At the proc spell's 0%, it would be 53-59 lower.
No filler explosive, because each 1s cast resets the swing.
notes: mksettings writes primarySeal Righteousness; set to Command to match the shipped preset's options (the APL never uses Cast Primary Seal, so DPS is unaffected). Undead since the 2026-10-27 race re-pick (the race sweep with each race's own rotation and gear, standards 29), was Human. The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD. Talents, rotation and its notes re-searched on 2026-11-01 for the launch realms' October 30 hotfix trees (1.60.1.70707+hf); the request is the earlier one with the new talentsString and rotation (tools/rotopt/paladin_presets.sh).
